newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Sidek debt problem lingers on.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Sidek debt problem lingers on.

text.p: The plans of holding company Grupo Sidek to restructure its debt will take longer than scheduled, the company's director general said Tuesday.

"From here to the year end, there will be some debt retired that could be announced," said Jose Luis Rebollar Corona. "The problem is that it (the process of restructuring) is very complex," he told journalists.
Sidek faced a debt payments crisis in the last months of 1995 and had previously announced that its proposals to restructure debts would be made known in October.
"Everyone, call them shareholders or investors, will be hurt (in the restructuring), but at the end of the day what I hope to leave behind is a company that is on its feet," he added.
He said the Guadalajara-based company also faced a current problem of being behind in tax payments with the government.
